title: Clagentic issuer trust and JWKS discovery
description: Verifier-side trust list (root) and the JWKS document a locator resolves to ($defs.jwks). Contract version 1.0.0; see docs/identity-contract.md section 5. A trusted issuer is matched by exact string equality; the locator only says where its keys are.

issuerIdentifier.description: Opaque, compared by exact equality. The four URI forms below also derive a JWKS locator when no explicit one is configured: https/http -> <iss>/.well-known/jwks.json, file -> the file itself, unix -> GET /.well-known/jwks.json over the socket.

locator.description: file: names the JWKS document. http(s): is the full document URL. unix: names a socket serving /.well-known/jwks.json.

jwk.description: Public keys only. No private parameter (d, p, q, dp, dq, qi, k) may appear.
